text:
nina: Heads-up — flaky streaming upload in sampleapp when server issues multi-hop redirects (307 -> 302). Repro on Pixel 8 emulator (Android 14).

omar: what failure mode? 401/connection reset/timeouts?

nina: 401 on the second hop. Logs show Authorization header present on initial POST, absent after the redirect to storage host. Streaming RequestBody aborted.

kevin: OkHttp intentionally removes sensitive headers for cross-host redirects. If you need them you either must handle redirects manually or provide an Authenticator to re-add credentials.

ravi: can you paste the client snippet from sampleapp?

nina: minimal setup: 
```
val client = OkHttpClient.Builder()
  .followRedirects(true)
  .followSslRedirects(true)
  .callTimeout(3, TimeUnit.MINUTES)
  .build()

val retrofit = Retrofit.Builder()
  .baseUrl("https://ingest.example.com/")
  .client(client)
  .build()
```
payload is a streaming RequestBody reading FileInputStream. First redirect is same-host, second hop is storage.example.com.

omar: FileInputStream can't rewind, so manual retry isn't feasible without buffering. Any workaround tested?

nina: temporary workaround: followRedirects(false) and perform manual follow using Request.Builder().headers(original.headers). We buffer small files into memory to support rewinds for the demo. Not suitable for large uploads.

kevin: alternative: server-side change to emit a single redirect to the final host, or issue a signed upload URL to avoid auth on client side.

ravi: also saw cookie jar not sending cookies to second host on emulator — could be contributing. Worth validating both auth header drop and cookie behavior separately.

kevin: add note for SDK parity: sampleapp currently only shows header-based auth. We should add an Authenticator example and a short doc blurb on redirect semantics for streaming.

nina: agreed, I'll open a small PR with: 1) TokenAuthenticator snippet; 2) manual redirect helper; 3) small discussion in onboarding about signed URLs for large uploads. Keep examples tiny to avoid onboarding friction.

omar: quick Authenticator example: 
```
class TokenAuthenticator : Authenticator {
  override fun authenticate(route: Route?, response: Response): Request? {
    val token = tokenProvider.currentToken()
    return response.request.newBuilder()
      .header("Authorization", "Bearer $token")
      .build()
  }
}
```

kevin: note: Authenticator is triggered on 401/407; it won't auto-run on every redirect. For redirects you still need manual follow if host changes.

ravi: can we add a CI e2e test with an emulator that performs a multi-hop redirect to catch regressions?

nina: ticket DEVEX-5133 created to track: "multi-host redirect drops auth/cookie for streaming uploads (Android)". Assigning to me.

bot: DEVEX-5133 created and linked to sampleapp repro.

kevin: also flag okhttp 4.x vs 5.x behavior differences in the changelog and sample README. Saved me hours last time.

nina: repro reduced to zero after server change (single final redirect). I'll update DEVEX-5133 with server CL and link PR to sampleapp.

omar: happy to help with a small unit harness for rewindable RequestBody.

nina: thanks — will loop you in on PR. Closing thread for now. :thumbsup:
